generate_dummy_code_pybind11: generate dummy C++ pybind11 binding code with a specified number of classes and random function signatures
generate_dummy_code_boost: generate dummy C++ Boost.Python binding code with a specified number of classes and random function signatures
benchmark_pybind11_compilation: benchmark pybind11 compilation time and output binary size across increasing class counts
benchmark_boost_compilation: benchmark Boost.Python compilation time and output binary size across increasing class counts
compare_binding_frameworks: compare pybind11 and Boost.Python compilation performance by generating and compiling equivalent binding code
